critical_code_review_comments: server.py total_aset_lancar uses max(kas,0)+max(bank,0) which silently drops negative kas from total assets. In the seed dataset kas saldo is -Rp 715jt (operational cash-out > cash-in because ALL time is aggregated) — total Aset Lancar hides that. Consider: (a) allow negative kas to flow through (kas would then reduce assets, and laba_ditahan plug remains balanced), or (b) surface a UI warning when kas<0. The neraca still balances only because laba_ditahan is computed as a plug (total_assets - liabilities - modal_disetor), which masks any inconsistency. NOT a regression per review note but worth revisiting.
App.js Reports component is one giant single-line function (~line 40) — hard to review/maintain. Should be split into subcomponents (BalanceSheet, DrillModal) and formatted normally.
balance_detail 'kas' rows include ALL historical sales/purchases/production/opex — no period filter. Aligns with reports snapshot approach (which is also all-time), so consistent. OK.
